Click keys or use your computer keyboard (A W S E D F T G Y H U J K = one octave). Hold a key to sustain — release to let it fade. In chords mode one held key sustains the whole chord. Turn on write and each key press is stamped into the poly pattern, step by step.

Sampler — Upload Your Own Sounds
Load a vocal, break or any audio. Each becomes a mixer channel with its own step lane — reshape it with pitch, trim, filters, drive, delay, reverb and reverse.

Effects — Space
reverb mix
EQ low
EQ mid
EQ high
limiter
The EQ shapes the whole mix — low (bass), mid (body/presence) and high (air). The limiter catches peaks so the master never clips; lower it for a louder, more "glued" sound.
